inspection.scope: 45/126 scalar potential, breaking-sector scope and accompanying10H discussion.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Displayed potential is the 45H plus complex126H symmetry-breaking sector, not a complete fermion-mass model. Phi adjoint45 has D5 [0,1,0,0,0]. Sigma126 is a complex self-dual rank-five tensor; orientation relative to the fixed D5 spinor-node convention is not established by a bare dimension. A further10H is needed for realistic Yukawas, discussed separately.

source_descriptions.reason: Full fermion/Higgs completion lies beyond displayed breaking-sector potential; canonical D5 orientation still requires an explicit tensor-to-node map, not a guessed126 label.
